The service dependency `gateway-api returned HTTP 503.` This was encountered during the reported failure and is the primary symptom under investigation.

`The root cause is not confirmed.` The HTTP 503 from gateway-api is a symptom; it remains unknown whether the origin is a gateway-side outage, upstream capacity issues, network problems, or behavior in our own client code.

- Gather gateway-api logs or status page output around the time of the 503 responses.
- Confirm how many retries actually occurred per failed request, given the limit of 2 in `src/retry.ts`.
- Determine whether the 503 responses were transient or sustained.

No fix has been applied and no test results are available at this time.
